summary: Lit construction equipment up to 34 ft high at Heathrow, operating only when runway 09L/27R is closed.
text:
LIT CONSTRUCTION EQPT OPR AT PSN 512839N 0002939W (HEATHROW AD). 
MAX HGT 34FT AGL/111FT AMSL. WILL ONLY OPR WHEN RWY 09L/27R IS CLSD. 
NO OPS IN LVP. CRANE REF 20260707134. UK EGLL OBST DATASET REFERS.
